inputs.text: Stylized science-fiction illustration, wide 2.4:1, bold graphic shapes, flat colour planes with soft gradients and clean ink outlines, retro concept art with a Moebius feel. A very dark round control hall at night: near-black walls, deep dark teal shadows, the only light comes from amber and cyan glows, low-key lighting. Rings of dark monitor walls show small amber and cyan metric graphs. At the centre of the room, sunk into a circular pit surrounded by a low railing, sits the Helm: a dense mass of black machinery with amber lights, and a beam of cyan light rises out of the pit up to the ceiling where it fans into rings. Small figures of the crew in matching grey-olive coveralls with a yellow stripe on the shoulders sit at consoles around it, seen from behind. In the foreground, seen from behind, stand a slender woman with short slicked-back blonde hair in a light grey uniform with yellow shoulder stripes, and a tall man in a long dark coat. Limited palette of black, deep teal, amber, cyan and cream, strictly no visible faces, no text, no logos.
